title: Printer queue stuck and print jobs will not clear
content: Printer queue stuck and print jobs will not clear. Reset printer settings to factory defaults, then clear the pending print jobs and retry printing. Recreate saved printer preferences afterward.

title: Updated print spooler recovery without factory reset
content: For printer queue problems, keep existing printer settings unchanged. Stop the print spooler, clear the pending jobs, restart the spooler, and retry printing. Do not perform a factory reset.
